- `description` (String) An additional explanation of exact attribute meaning, possible values, etc.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `input_type` (String) The input method. `text` is most common and means simply free text, `popup` i a closed list of values from which one or many can be selected and `script` value is calculated and can never be set directly.
- `multi_value` (Boolean)
- `name` (String) A human-readable name by which attribute can be referred to.
- `options` (Set of String) A closed list of possible values (applies to `popup` input type).
- `values` (Set of String) A value of extension attribute, in some rare cases there may be multiple values present, hence the array.
